skills.name: arc-audit
skills.description: Read-only evaluation (只读) producing ranked, evidence-backed code findings without editing code: diff/PR review (代码评审, 能不能合), project health, code rot and tech debt (体检, 技术债, 过度设计), HTTP API design review (HTTP API, 接口设计, 上传约束, JSON字段限制), AppSec threat model and pen test (AppSec, 威胁建模, 渗透测试), security/secret/dependency SAST scans (安全扫描, Semgrep, 漏洞) and authorized DAST. Not for fixes (use arc-code), tests (use arc-verify), or CNB PR comments (use cnb).

intent_router.Condition: HTTP API, upload caps or JSON field bounds (HTTP API, 接口设计, 上传约束, JSON字段限制)
Diff, PR, branch or patch review (代码评审)
Health, code rot, over-engineering or tech debt (体检, 技术债)
Security, AppSec, AuthZ, threat model or race/ledger invariants (AppSec, 漏洞)
Scanner run: Semgrep/Trivy/secrets/DAST (安全扫描, Semgrep, DAST)

skills.name: arc-code
skills.description: Every task that changes source code: implement features or endpoints (写代码, 实现, 开发功能, 落地改动), build frontend/UI pages (前端, shadcn, 小程序), fix bugs/errors/incidents by evidence-first root-cause repair (修复, 报错, 根因, incident), refactor (重构), apply Go DIP/usecase layering (DIP, usecase, 分层), write comments (注释), or add Gin SSR timing probes (Gin SSR, 计时, 探针, 埋点). Enforces write_scope isolation and atomic gate.sh checks. Not for review (use arc-audit), verification suites (use arc-verify), or planning (use arc-plan).

skills.name: arc-explore

Maintains the arc Zoekt index (arc-idx: arc idx doctor, index, daemon). Not for edits (use arc-code), review (use arc-audit), or tests (use arc-verify).

Callers, call chain or data flow (谁调用, 调用链)

skills.name: arc-vet
skills.description: Open-source due diligence before adding a dependency or generic component (开源选型, 技术选型, 引入依赖, 不要重复造轮子, build vs buy): checks local code and standard library first, compares ≥3 GitHub candidates on substantive maintenance, stable releases, license compatibility (许可证), advisories and integration cost with dated source URLs, rejects archived or ≥36-month-stale repos (停更), and writes a decision record (选型记录). Not for implementation (use arc-code), CVE scans (use arc-audit), or research articles (use research-write).

intent_router.Condition: Existing dependency is stale, archived, relicensed or vulnerable (停更, 换库)
